create_openai_image_generation_handler: create an OpenAIImageGenerationHandler instance to process image generation requests with guardrails
process_input_messages: process input prompt by applying guardrails to the text content of an image generation request
process_output_response: process output image response, returning it unchanged since images do not need text guardrails
apply_guardrail_to_prompt: apply a custom guardrail to an image generation prompt string and return the guardrailed prompt
test_openai_image_generation_handler: test the OpenAIImageGenerationHandler class and its async methods for guardrail processing
